objective: Find the smallest trustworthy PRE-only input set that preserves useful predictive performance, so simulation never waits on unnecessary fields.
baseline_principles: Never use result, payout, or future information in PRE prediction.
Do not require live odds for prediction generation unless the exact frozen model mathematically requires odds.
Do not infer race membership from event-level rosters.
Do not perform fuzzy rider identity joins.
If a field can be removed without material predictive degradation, demote it to optional.

trial_order.name: style_increment
trial_order.purpose: Measure whether style materially improves prediction versus the identity core.

trial_order.name: circumference_increment
trial_order.purpose: Measure the frozen circumference adjustment contribution.

trial_order.name: nonessential_candidate_fields
test_individually: other PRE-only metadata not required by the frozen model
trial_order.purpose: Only retain fields that produce repeatable material improvement.

odds_handling.output_when_missing: candidate ticket plus minimum acceptable odds threshold
odds_handling.during_real_execution: compare actual live odds to threshold before manual Owner purchase
odds_handling.during_formal_roi_validation: use genuine pre-close odds only; never reconstruct after result

promotion_rule: A field becomes required only if the frozen model requires it or controlled ablation shows material repeatable predictive benefit sufficient to justify its availability cost.
progress_effect: Creating or running this plan does not itself increase formal scientific validation percent without new genuine evidence.
